newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil real drops 0.09 to close at 1.0585 per dlr.
newsitem.headline: Brazil real drops 0.09 to close at 1.0585 per dlr.

text.p: Brazil's real dropped 0.09 percent to close at 1.0585 reais per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market on continued short supply of dollars, dealers said.
Because of the low liquidity, the Central Bank sold dollars at 1.0585 real per greenback to help some banks square off their positions for the weekend, they said.
In addition, the auction helped to maintain the trading level within the mini-band of 1.0535 real to 1.0585 real per dollar, which was set last Tuesday, traders added.
In the interbank foreign exchange floating rate market, the real dropped 0.01 percent to close at 1.0588 real per greenback.
In the illegal parallel market, the real rose 0.18 percent to end at 1.083 per dollar.
